Per seat, per month,
no line-item roulette
One number covers the helpdesk, the cloud, the security and the essentials. It goes up when you hire and down when you don't. That's the whole model.
✓  A named engineer who knows your stack
We shadow your current setup, document everything, then take the pager. No cliff, no chaos week.
Leaving us takes one email and gets you every password, licence and diagram in a tidy handover. Confidence, not lock-in.
Laptops and kit at our price with the invoice attached. We make money on service, not margin archaeology.
Monthly, one page: what broke, what we fixed, what we'd spend next. The forty-page version exists if you insist.
Two hours. One report. Zero obligation.

A read-only look at your stack: security posture, licence waste, backup reality, single points of failure. You get the findings whether or not we ever speak again. About a third of audits end with 'you're fine, change these four settings'.
Median time from call to report: six working days.
